It connects an AI to your live Houdini session — not as a wrapper that hides complexity, but as a co-pilot that helps you navigate it. Let me create a summary report: ## Summary: Pentagram Panel Redesign Status Based on my exploration of the Synapse codebase, here's what I found about the Pentagram panel redesign: ### What the Pentagram Redesign Achieved The Pentagram redesign is a **two-commit improvement** to the Synapse panel's chat interface (commits `f3f01fd` and `9a56bc3`, plus follow-up `e6cedd9`): #### **Commit f3f01fd: "Pentagram panel redesign — chat-dominant layout, ~384px reclaimed"** This was the major structural overhaul: - **Merged title + status bars** into a unified 40px header (down from 64px + 48px = 112px) - **Removed 6-button tool grid** → moved to "..." overflow dropdown menu - **Activity log collapsed by default** with toggle button (reclaimed vertical space) - **Compact 28px footer** with Disconnect + version + WebSocket URL - **Message deduplication** in system messages with 5-second hash window - **Context bar alignment** to 16px margins with transparent background - **Reclaimed ~384px** of vertical space for the dominant chat interface #### **Commit 9a56bc3: "Pentagram typography pass — quiet system chrome, WhatsApp pill input"** Typography refinement focused on visual hierarchy: - **Chat base font** 12pt → 9pt (was rendering huge on 4K displays) - **SYNAPSE/You labels** demoted from bold colored headlines to small uppercase SILVER/SLATE labels - **System messages (_sys)** dropped to SLATE/SIZE_LABEL — whisper, not shout - **Send button** redesigned as solid cyan pill (background-color: #00D4FF) - **Input field** restyled as dark pill with 20px border-radius - **Chat content dominates**, chrome recedes - Applied WhatsApp-style pill design to input/send button pair #### **Commit e6cedd9: "switch all inline HTML font-size from pt to px — stops DPI doubling"** DPI fix (latest): - Switched all inline HTML `font-size` from `pt` to `px` in QTextEdit rich HTML - Fixes 4K 200% scaling DPI-doubling issue (9pt was rendering as ~18px) - Affected: system messages, chat labels, tool status, welcome screen, help text - Provides pixel-exact control --- ### What's Still TODO **One incomplete item explicitly marked in commit 9a56bc3:** ``` Still TODO: "You" labels in slash command displays need same treatment. ``` The SYNAPSE label got the full typography treatment (uppercase, SILVER color, SIZE_LABEL, letter-spacing, no bold), but **"You" labels in various slash command displays still use the old style**: ```python # Line 994 in synapse_panel.pypanel — OLD STYLE: 'You' # Still bold, still colored (SIGNAL=#00D4FF) ``` Compare to SYNAPSE (line 1089-1090 — NEW STYLE): ```python '' 'SYNAPSE' # Uppercase-small, SILVER color, letter-spacing ``` **Affected "You" label locations** (grep results show these at lines: 994, 1315, 1393, 1519, 1570, 1918): - `/hda` command user message display - `/diagnose` command output - `/explain` command output - `/trace` command output - `/vex` command output - Possibly others in slash command handlers **What needs to be done:** 1. Replace `You` with the same minimal uppercase pattern as SYNAPSE 2. Use SILVER color (not SIGNAL) 3. Add `font-size: {}px` (using SIZE_LABEL) 4. Add `letter-spacing: 1px` 5. Drop the `` tag for consistency 6. Apply to all 6+ instances across slash command handlers --- ### Current Unstaged Changes The three modified files (`README.md`, `python/synapse/server/main_thread.py`, `tests/test_main_thread.py`) are **unrelated to Pentagram redesign**: - `README.md`: Version bump (5.8.0 → 6.0.0), feature documentation expansion (from 12 bullet points to 13 detailed features) - `python/synapse/server/main_thread.py`: Main-thread detection fix (added caching of main_thread_id to detect Qt slot calls already on main thread, prevents deadlock) - `tests/test_main_thread.py`: Tests for the new main-thread detection logic These appear to be concurrent work, not part of Pentagram completion. --- ### Design System Files The design tokens and stylesheet are well-structured: - **`~/.synapse/design/tokens.py`** — Color palette, typography scale, spacing constants - **`~/.synapse/design/synapse_styles.py`** — QSS stylesheet generator (creates all Qt widget styles from tokens) - **`~/.synapse/houdini/python_panels/synapse_panel.pypanel`** — The actual panel widget (1900+ lines) The Pentagram redesign is **fully implemented** except for the TODO item.
